clues.text: Samson found a swarm of bees in a lion's carcass and scooped this out to eat.
Not knowing Saul's oath, Jonathan tasted this from the end of his staff in a forest, and his eyes brightened.
Preaching in the wilderness of Judea, John the Baptist, dressed in camel's hair, lived on this, found wild.
In the law of grain offerings, this, like leaven, was never to be burned as a food offering to the LORD.
In the wilderness, the manna Israel gathered was white like coriander seed and tasted like wafers made with this.
When Ezekiel ate the scroll God gave him, it tasted as sweet as this in his mouth.
God told Moses He would rescue His people from Egypt and bring them to a good land flowing with milk and this.
